His ownership mindset, operational history, and agile exposure are evident, though his limited explicit AI/ML product experience and lack of clear on-call/incident-response documentation are minor gaps.

Direct hands-on experience with AI-agent tooling and MCP code generators at re:cinq
Strong full-stack ownership, operational rigor, and open-source leadership across diverse tech stacks
concerns: No explicit mention of on-call rotation or incident response processes in past roles
